rule: "session-summary" is 15 characters — ODD — so the reference is A and the app is B.

A.what: Du Chinese flashcard review session: coloured segment rail across the top, a study card carrying hanzi + tone-coloured pinyin + gloss + a full example sentence with per-syllable pinyin and translation, and a Forgot / Almost / Got it! action row.

B.what: hskquiz session summary at 7/10 (http://127.0.0.1:5177/quiz/1?state=summary), 375x812 @2x, above the fold.

whyThisPair: The Du Chinese review screen is the only reference screen that is the end/middle of a study run rather than a dictionary lookup: it pairs a coloured progress rail with word-level study cards and a bottom action row, which is exactly the anatomy of the summary under review.
